signal: Sage raised a $65M Series C led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives and took $50M in growth capital in 2026 to scale its AI monitoring platform for senior care

email.body1:
Doug, saw Sage closed its $65M Series C and added $50M in growth capital to scale the senior care platform.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market communities and operators than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Sage off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Doug, quick follow-up for Sage.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Sage needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Doug, last bit of proof for Sage.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sage's reply rate likely compares to other Series-C startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Doug, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Sage either way.
